parameters.name: AssociatedDataOnly
parameters.description: Whether to filter out attributes that can be associated with other assets.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language type for requesting and receiving messages, with a default value of **zh**. The values can be: - **zh**: Chinese - **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.
